scripts.dev: npm run build && wrangler pages dev dist --port 8788
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name danis --branch main
scripts.db:local: wrangler d1 execute danis --local --file=migrations/0001_orders.sql && wrangler d1 execute danis --local --file=migrations/0002_products.sql
scripts.db:remote: wrangler d1 execute danis --remote --file=migrations/0001_orders.sql && wrangler d1 execute danis --remote --file=migrations/0002_products.sql
